page.overview:
Who is Ashai?

If speaks to while she is walking through , she introduces herself and asks if he is interested in taking her class, "Voe and You". explains that she teaches a relationship class during the day and a Cooking class at night. encourages to attend the Cooking class at her home during the night and her relationship class in the barracks during the day.

Speaking to Ashai in the classroom in the barracks before her relationship class begins, she asks if is interested in sitting in. She then assures that there is no hurry and that class does not begin until everyone arrives.

If speaks to during her relationship class, she invites to observe if he is interested. If rejects her offer, asks if already has a loved one, to which scratches the back of his head in embarrassment. then explains that the young girls in her class have never even met a man before and that it is her duty to prepare them for the world outside of .

Should agree to observe the class, instructs everyone to demonstrate what they have been learning. then asks the class what to do when a "handsome voe" approaches them on the street. stands up and answers that she would wave casually yet remain prepared in case he is a distraction for a bandit ambush. praises for her solution and then reminds the class that sometimes men only look suspicious from being intimidated by a . then stands up to share her solution, saying that she would enthusiastically greet the man and approach with her hands empty. praises for her optimistic approach, adding that friendliness is a great way to relax others. Lastly, stands to share her solution, saying that she would attack the man when he least suspects it. dismisses 's solution and tells her that it is a crime.
